effect_description_eng:
While you have a Tamer, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Main] Choose 1 Tamer. You may play 1 Digimon card with the same color as the chosen Tamer with a play cost of 3 or less from your hand or trash without paying the cost.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] You may play 1 Tamer card from your hand without paying the cost. Then, add this card to your hand.
